name: farkasAugA
type: def farkasAugA (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜) (c : Fin n → 𝕜) (d : 𝕜) : FarkasAugRow I → Fin (n+1) → 𝕜 | Sum.inl i, j => Fin.lastCases (-b i) (fun j' => A i j') j | Sum.inr false, j => Fin.lastCases 1 (fun _ => (0 : 𝕜)) j | Sum.inr true, j => Fin.lastCases d (fun j' => -c j') j /-- Augmented RHS `b_aug : FarkasAugRow I → 𝕜`. -/

name: farkasAugB
type: def farkasAugB (b : I → 𝕜) : FarkasAugRow I → 𝕜 | Sum.inl _ => 0 | Sum.inr false => 0 | Sum.inr true => 1 /-! ### Simp lemmas for `farkasAugA` and `farkasAugB` -/ @[simp] theorem farkasAugA_inl_castSucc (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜) (c : Fin n → 𝕜) (d : 𝕜) (i : I) (j' : Fin n) : farkasAugA A b c d (Sum.inl i) j'.castSucc = A i j'

name: farkas_lemma
type: theorem farkas_lemma (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜) (c : Fin n → 𝕜) (d : 𝕜) (hS : IsFeasible A b) : (∀ x : Fin n → 𝕜, (∀ i, b i ≤ ∑ j, A i j * x j) → d ≤ ∑ j, c j * x j) ↔ (∃ u : I → 𝕜, (∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, u i * A i j = c j) ∧ d ≤ ∑ i, u i * b i)
